name: Random draws and groups
description: Choose entries, shuffle lists or draw inclusive integers with browser cryptographic randomness.
listHelp: One entry per line. Blank lines are ignored; duplicate names remain separate entries until you remove duplicates.
numberHelp: Use safe integer endpoints spanning at most 4,294,967,296 values. Draw up to 100,000 numbers; without repetition, the requested count must fit the range.
invalidCount: Enter a positive integer count within the available entries or range (maximum 100,000).
invalidRange: Enter safe integer endpoints with minimum ≤ maximum and a span of at most 4,294,967,296 values.
empty: Enter at least one nonblank list entry.
